Name: Cozy Tent Cabins
Author: CactusCouch
Description:
[b][u]Description[/u][/b]
Transform your co-op farm into a cozy, rustic campsite! [b]Log Cabin Tents[/b] is a Content Patcher retexture that replaces the standard wooden Log Cabin with a detailed canvas tent equipped with outdoor barrels, supplies, and hanging lanterns.

[b][u]Main Features[/u][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Seasonal Variations:[/b] The tent graphics update dynamically each season—including custom seasonal foliage, pots, and decorations for Spring, Summer, Fall, and Winter.[/*]
[*][b][u]NEW:[/u] Tent theme variations have been added!  5 Selectable Tent Themes: forager, farmer, rancher, miner, and fisher.[/b][/*]
[*][b][u]NEW:[/u]  In-Game Customization: Native support for Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM).[/b][/*]
[*][b]Lightweight & Clean:[/b] Purely aesthetic retexture targeting only the Log Cabin, keeping your other farm buildings and other cabin types untouched.[/*]
[*][b]1.6 Ready:[/b] Built and formatted specifically for Stardew Valley 1.6 and Content Patcher 2.0+.[/*]
[/list]
[b][u]Requirements[/u][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] [/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url]  [i]Optional/ recommended [/i][/*]
[/list][b][u]Installation Instructions[/u][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Download and install [b]SMAPI[/b] and [b]Content Patcher[/b].[/*]
[*]Download this mod's ZIP file from the [b]Files[/b] tab.[/*]
[*]Extract the
[code]TentCabinsMod[/code]folder directly into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder:
[list]
[*][i]Windows:[/i]
[code]C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods[/code][/*]
[*][i]Mac:[/i]
[code]~/Library/Application Support/Steam/steamapps/common/Stardew Valley/Contents/MacOS/Mods[/code][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]Launch the game using
[code]StardewModdingAPI.exe[/code]and enjoy![/*]
[/list]To uninstall, simply delete the
[code]TentCabinsMod[/code]folder from your
[code]Mods[/code]directory.


[b][u]How to Change Your Tent Style[/u][/b]

Players can select their preferred tent style using either of these two methods:
[b]Method 1: In-Game Options Menu (Recommended)[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url].[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley.[/*]
[*]Click the [b]gear icon[/b] in the bottom-left corner of the title screen (or scroll to the bottom of the in-game options tab).[/*]
[*]Select [b]Seasonal Tent Cabins[/b] from your mod list.[/*]
[*]Choose your favorite tent style (
[code]forager[/code],
[code]farmer[/code],
[code]rancher[/code],
[code]miner[/code],
[code]fisher[/code]) from the [b]TentStyle[/b] dropdown menu and click [b]Save[/b].[/*]
[/list]
